about: Predator -> prey slugs for the behaviour audit (scripts/ark-behaviour-audit.mts): the ecology lane's food links (scratchpad ark-eco/food_links.interim.json, 2026-11-10 export), kept where both are vertebrate body plans, the link is realm_ok and the predator eats meat, fish or carrion.
